question: Is the MediaFire Pro 50 GB per-file limit 50,000,000,000 bytes or 53,687,091,200 bytes? The upgrade page states '50 GB per file' with no byte count; its only unit line, '1 TB = 1024 GB', sits in the Business plan slider block and may not govern the Pro bullets.
why: per_object_cap.bytes holds 50000000000 (decimal reading of a stated GB figure) but the page's unit line points to binary; only an upload test above 50,000,000,000 bytes or a vendor help page can settle it, and the difference is 7.4%.
